knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The work order sets the scope. A treatment request outside it is recorded and referred.
The guideline names three duties. Which one applies depends on control of the premises and the work.
The contamination class and the scope need a competent assessment before work starts.

practicalCriteria: In a training scenario with a stated work order, the learner identifies the work that is inside it and the request that is outside it, and writes the referral.
The learner separates observed, uncertain and unverified items in a written record for the scenario.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: Work proceeds outside the written work order.
A competent assessment of contamination level has not been recorded before work starts.
